subject: textures DELTA7 plan: texture view methods live in render_encoder; handoff/patch needed
body:
Read TASK/HANDOFF/board. Discovery before editing: TeguTexture is NOT in compute_frontend.m; it is defined in render-owned `metal/tegu/render_encoder.inc:158/@implementation:200`, included by library_frontend.inc:336. The audited helper `n2t_view_format_check(allocation,view,...)` already exists in textures-owned `nord2_texture_resources.h`.

Proposed implementation contract (need render handoff or root ownership grant; I will not edit render_encoder.inc otherwise):
- `-newTextureViewWithPixelFormat:` returns nil for a null/foreign/unknown texture, except valid alias; validates `n2t_view_format_check(self->format,viewFormat,NULL,NULL)==N2T_OK` (sRGB/UNORM/SNORM/UINT/SINT same block/order only; no BGR/RGB, depth, width change, compressed HDR/LDR mismatch). View has same kind/dimensions/samples/mip count/array/layers/usage/options; shares the exact backing (retain buffer, importedOwner/surface/handle, shadow surface), copies mip/levelDepth/slice/layer arrays byte-for-byte; format=view; rowBytes/level offsets unchanged. No allocation/copy.
- `-newTextureViewWithPixelFormat:textureType:levels:slices:` initially accept only the trivially exact case: same textureType, levels.location==0 && levels.length==levelCount, slices.location==0 && slices.length==layers/arrayLength; otherwise nil. This avoids inventing 3D/array/cube subview semantics while making the CA call safe. If render wants ranges, a later additive helper can derive offsets.
- Views must remain `TeguTexture` owned-class and device identity via retained buffer/importedOwner. `dealloc` must release the shared references exactly once per view. Zero-copy IOSurface/shadow needs explicit retain of importedOwner/importedSurface/release callback and shadowSurface CF-retain; no raw copy.
- Nil is acceptable on refusal (CA tolerates nil per audit); log bounded TEGU_TEXTURE_VIEW_REFUSED reason.
- Host tests should use the real frontend class: valid BGRA8<->sRGB alias (find exact audited pair), invalid RGB/BGR/depth/width, imported/shadow view sharing, levels/slices exact vs refused, device/retain lifecycle under ASan. I can provide a patch or implement if render grants handoff. Textures will add a pure helper/test only if needed.

Please render ACK handoff or root grant render_encoder ownership for this method. No phone/native/commit.
